records.description_rewritten: A former men's public restroom on Tempelhofer Feld near the baseball area is a gay-szene.net lead. One first-person March 13 2026 comment found the toilets open but a former opening between stalls sealed with a steel plate and no activity. Later indexed October 2026 comments report access, with some users seeing no other visitors; these are inconsistent with any assertion of steady cruising. The field's controlled gates and seasonal closing times determine access.

supplemental_evidence.note: Detailed March 2026 dated forum; indexed October 2026 updates on same page.
Official park operating and preservation information; verify hours on official page before using.

A January 10 2024 forum note described sporadic cruising near the eastern public WC, while December 2021 and earlier posts described a decline following park redesign and poor visibility. No verified visitor evidence after November 2025. Historical safety worries cannot be generalised to present conditions.

No recent visitors found.
